activity_records.endpoint_description: Murine erythrocyte hemolysis after 1 h peptide exposure

assay_conditions.source_context: Results text states Pal-alpha-MSH(6-13) showed negligible hemolysis up to 62.5 uM; hemolysis method used murine RBCs and 0.1% Triton X-100 as positive control.

replicate_statistics.reported: duplicate experiments on two different days; figure reports mean +/- SEM

activity_records.worker2_review_notes: Primary text supports <=1% hemolysis through the tested 62.5 uM concentration.

assay_conditions.source_context: Results text reports the HC50 value for Pal-alpha-MSH(11-13) as 62.5 uM.

replicate_statistics.reported: duplicate experiments on two different days; figure reports mean +/- SEM

activity_records.worker2_review_notes: Primary text gives the HC50 directly; no unit conversion was applied.

activity_records.endpoint_description: 3T3 murine fibroblast killing after 2 h peptide exposure

assay_conditions.source_context: Results text says Pal-alpha-MSH(6-13) did not exhibit a detrimental effect on 3T3 viability at 50 uM; MTT method measured percent survival after 2 h.

replicate_statistics.reported: cytotoxicity assay done twice independently in duplicates; figure reports mean +/- SEM

activity_records.worker2_review_notes: The 0% killing row follows the linked DBAASP annotation and is bounded by the source prose statement of no detrimental effect at 50 uM.

activity_records.endpoint_description: 3T3 murine fibroblast viability after 2 h peptide exposure

assay_conditions.source_context: Results text reports Pal-alpha-MSH(11-13) at 20 and 50 uM resulted in at least 85.5% viable cells; database expresses the complement as 14.5% killing at 50 uM.

replicate_statistics.reported: cytotoxicity assay done twice independently in duplicates; figure reports mean +/- SEM

database_traceability.database_value_caveat: Primary text supports >=85.5% viability; exact 14.5% killing is retained as the database complement rather than independently re-estimated from the figure image.

activity_records.worker2_review_notes: No figure-derived exact value was fabricated; final row uses the prose-supported viability bound.
